item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"latent_frames","expression":"z.shape[2]","rationale":"Tracks decoder invocations and per-frame cache-management overhead."},{"name":"first_frame_area","expression":"z.shape[0] * z.shape[3] * z.shape[4]","rationale":"Tracks spatial work for the first frame, which skips cached temporal upsampling."},{"name":"subsequent_frame_area","expression":"z.shape[0] * (z.shape[2] - 1) * z.shape[3] * z.shape[4]","rationale":"Tracks convolution, normalization, copying, and upsampling work for subsequent frames."},{"name":"attention_work","expression":"z.shape[0] * z.shape[2] * (z.shape[3] * z.shape[4]) ** 2","rationale":"Tracks the quadratic spatial component of decoder attention."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count combines per-frame overhead, distinct spatial costs for first and subsequent frames, and quadratic spatial attention work."}
